title: Game record
description: One line of a game's JSONL record, written by play-game (src/dont_say_oyster/record.py). Fields: SPEC.md, Implementation, Experiment result format, and Evaluation, Metrics. Every object lists every one of its fields as required and allows no other, so a record is complete when it validates; a key that does not apply is present with null or an empty list. The two exceptions are a lookup's arguments and result, which are what the model sent and what the search tool returned.

official_name.description: The card's official name, in Chinese, so matched_name reads as the official name or an alias.

result.description: One of the four F outcomes.

matched_name.description: The card name a right guess equals [R20]; null otherwise.

rounds.description: Rounds begun: the round counter as F left it.
One entry per round begun, in order.

calls.description: Every model call of the game, in order (SPEC.md Metrics, Per model call).

settings.description: The settings play-game resolved for the game.

memory.description: The game's cross-game memory (SPEC.md Cross-game memory definition; Implementation, Experiment result format): null in V0-V2, whose memory toggle is off.

game.description: The game's number in the batch; its memory files carry it (Storage).

entry.description: The accepted memory entry; null when the game was not written for the role.

summary.description: The accepted rolling summary; null before game six and when the game was not written.

written.description: False when the third output still failed the Check rule and the previous game's memory was copied forward.

failed.description: Every output the Check rule failed, in order, the refused third included; those with attempt at most redos were sent back with the fixed message.

tokens.description: Token count of the memory part (SPEC.md Metrics, Per game): the memory block the role read at game start (memory.render of the previous game's file; the empty memory's (none) markers in game 1), counted by the role's own model as prompt_eval_count of one /api/generate request with the block as a raw prompt, num_predict 1, and the role's num_ctx and keep_alive; a measurement after H, not an entry in calls.

ordinal.description: The ordinal of the calls entry that produced it.

summary.description: Null with the entry-only schema of games 1 to 5.

reasons.description: Why it failed, each reason once in this order [R6], [R22].

owed.description: What the Describer was asked for [R10].

reached_text.description: The description or answer that reached the Guesser; null when the round ended in C [R14].

rejected.description: The round's rejected descriptions with their fail reasons [R13].

sent_back.description: Every output the program sent back [R11], [R17], [R40], and the [R40] second reason the fixed message replaced (replaced true).

call.description: The round's tool-loop call index, the call key of its calls entry.

arguments.description: The arguments as the model sent them.

result.description: The search result, or the message for a call that was not searched.

guesser_output.description: The guess or valid question; null when the round ended before one.

violating_question.description: The third invalid question when the round ended in a Guesser violation [R17].

violating_text.description: The description or answer when the round ended in a Describer violation [R11], [R21].

call.description: The round's tool-loop call index on a tool-bound call; null otherwise.
